Copy a file with optional gzip compression or decompression

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
fast_copy.Rd

Copies a file from file to outfile, automatically compressing or decompressing the file when the .gz extension differs between the source and destination.

Usage

fast_copy(
  file,
  outfile,
  pigz_path = NULL,
  compress_method = "R",
  num_threads = 0,
  quiet = TRUE
)

Arguments

file

Character string giving the path to the source file.

outfile

Character string giving the path to the destination file. A filename ending in .gz indicates that the destination should be gzip-compressed.

pigz_path

Optional path to the pigz executable. If NULL (default), resolved via getOption("vtamR.pigz_path") or the PATH (see get_path).

compress_method

Character string specifying the compression method. Supported values are "R", "pigz", and "gzip". Defaults to "R".

num_threads

Integer specifying the number of threads to use when compress_method = "pigz". A value of 0 uses all detected CPU cores. Defaults to 0.

quiet

Logical indicating whether informational messages should be suppressed. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

Invisibly returns TRUE if the operation succeeds.

Details

If both files have the same compression status (both compressed or both uncompressed), file.copy is used directly. If the source and destination differ, smart_gzip is used to perform the compression or decompression.

Compression and decompression can be performed using R or external compression utilities. The available methods are "R", "pigz", and "gzip". The "pigz" method supports multithreading.

The compression status of a file is determined from whether its filename ends in .gz.

If file and outfile have the same compression status, the source file is copied directly using file.copy with overwrite = TRUE.

If file is gzip-compressed and outfile is not, the file is decompressed. If file is uncompressed and outfile ends in .gz, the file is compressed.

When compression or decompression is required, the operation is delegated to smart_gzip. The source file is not removed after a successful conversion.

See also

smart_gzip, file.copy

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Copy an uncompressed file
fast_copy("input.txt", "output.txt")

# Compress while copying
fast_copy("input.txt", "output.txt.gz")

# Decompress while copying
fast_copy("input.txt.gz", "output.txt")

# Use pigz for multithreaded compression
fast_copy("input.txt", "output.txt.gz",
          compress_method = "pigz",
          num_threads = 4)
} # }
